name: False Aura
description:
You touch an object or creature and place an illusion upon it that gives false information to spells that identify, locate, or observe.

You may make a magical object appear mundane or vice versa. You may give an object or creature an aura that makes it appear to be from a particular mestiere (and school within that mestiere, if you choose). For a creature, you may give it a false profile, including its creature type, size and/or native biome.

The illusion only provides false information to spells. It does not disguise the object or creature from ordinary observation.

This effect lasts for 1 day. If you cast this spell on the same creature or object with an identical illusion for 7 consecutive days, the illusion persists indefinitely.

Describe the illusion.
